t.why: It is very close to India and has yet to settle its border with China.
t.rel: A small kingdom between India and China. Its diplomacy and economy are very close to India's, and it has yet to establish formal relations or settle its border with China.
t.know: Forests cover more than 70% of the land, so it absorbs more carbon than it emits.
t.etext: Its biggest income is selling hydropower from dammed rivers to India. It charges tourists a high daily fee, earning a lot from relatively few visitors.
